# Cookie Database
> A public database and documentation hub for internet cookies, trackers, and consent management information.

Cookie Database provides searchable records for cookies and trackers, along with supporting documentation about consent categories, scans, and related privacy tooling.

## Cookie Records
- [Cookie Search](https://cookiedatabase.org/): Search and browse cookie and tracker records across websites and services.
- [Cookie Categories](https://cookiedatabase.org/cookie-categories/): Overview of cookie purpose categories used to classify stored technologies.
- [Service Search](https://cookiedatabase.org/service/): Browse services associated with cookies and tracking technologies.
- [Tracker Search](https://cookiedatabase.org/tracker/): Explore tracker-related records and associated identifiers.
- [Vendor Search](https://cookiedatabase.org/vendor/): Browse vendors connected to cookies, services, and tracking technologies.

## Cookie Information
- [What Are Cookies?](https://cookiedatabase.org/what-are-cookies/): Introductory explanation of cookies and how websites use them.
- [First-Party Cookies](https://cookiedatabase.org/first-party-cookies/): Explains cookies set directly by the website a user visits.
- [Third-Party Cookies](https://cookiedatabase.org/third-party-cookies/): Describes cookies set by external domains and embedded services.
- [Session Cookies](https://cookiedatabase.org/session-cookies/): Explains temporary cookies that expire after a browsing session.
- [Persistent Cookies](https://cookiedatabase.org/persistent-cookies/): Describes cookies that remain stored for a defined period.

## Consent and Categories
- [Necessary Cookies](https://cookiedatabase.org/cookie-categories/necessary/): Cookies classified as essential for core site functionality.
- [Preferences Cookies](https://cookiedatabase.org/cookie-categories/preferences/): Cookies used to remember settings and user choices.
- [Statistics Cookies](https://cookiedatabase.org/cookie-categories/statistics/): Cookies used for analytics, measurement, and aggregated reporting.
- [Marketing Cookies](https://cookiedatabase.org/cookie-categories/marketing/): Cookies used for advertising, profiling, and cross-site tracking.
- [Unclassified Cookies](https://cookiedatabase.org/cookie-categories/unclassified/): Cookies not yet assigned to a definitive category.

## Scanning and Detection
- [Cookie Scan](https://cookiedatabase.org/cookie-scan/): Information about scanning websites to detect cookies and trackers.
- [Website Scan](https://cookiedatabase.org/website-scan/): Overview of site-level scanning for cookie and tracker discovery.
- [Cookie Report](https://cookiedatabase.org/cookie-report/): Details about reporting and reviewing detected cookie data.
- [Tracker Detection](https://cookiedatabase.org/tracker-detection/): Information about identifying tracking technologies on websites.

## Services and Vendors
- [Services](https://cookiedatabase.org/service/): Index of services that set or use cookies and trackers.
- [Vendors](https://cookiedatabase.org/vendor/): Index of organizations associated with tracked technologies.
- [Google](https://cookiedatabase.org/service/google/): Service record for Google-related cookies and tracking technologies.
- [YouTube](https://cookiedatabase.org/service/youtube/): Service record for YouTube cookies and embedded media technologies.
- [Facebook](https://cookiedatabase.org/service/facebook/): Service record for Facebook-related cookies and tracking technologies.

## Privacy Knowledge Base
- [Privacy Statement](https://cookiedatabase.org/privacy-statement/): Site privacy information describing data handling and user rights.
- [Cookie Policy](https://cookiedatabase.org/cookie-policy/): Explains how the site itself uses cookies and similar technologies.
- [Disclaimer](https://cookiedatabase.org/disclaimer/): Legal disclaimer covering informational use and liability limitations.
- [About](https://cookiedatabase.org/about/): Background information about the Cookie Database project and purpose.
- [Contact](https://cookiedatabase.org/contact/): Contact information for questions, corrections, or support.

## Platform and Integrations
- [WordPress Plugin](https://cookiedatabase.org/wordpress-plugin/): Information about WordPress integration for cookie and consent workflows.
- [CMP Integration](https://cookiedatabase.org/cmp/): Overview of consent management platform-related functionality.
- [Consent Management](https://cookiedatabase.org/consent-management/): Information about managing cookie consent and categorization practices.

## Updates and Articles
- [Blog](https://cookiedatabase.org/blog/): Articles and updates related to cookies, privacy, and tracking technologies.
- [Latest Posts](https://cookiedatabase.org/blog/): Recent educational and product-related articles from the site.
- [Cookie Law](https://cookiedatabase.org/cookie-law/): Information about cookie compliance and legal considerations.
- [Tracking Technologies](https://cookiedatabase.org/tracking-technologies/): Articles explaining non-cookie tracking methods and related concepts.
